findings.text: Using assert for input validation is unsafe because assertions are disabled with Python's -O flag. If self.header is None and assertions are disabled, the code proceeds to line 12 and raises AttributeError instead of failing fast, causing inconsistent error behavior depending on interpreter optimization settings.

Same issue: assert self.body is not None will be skipped with -O flag, allowing the code to reach line 16 where accessing self.body.rows on a None value raises AttributeError instead of the intended AssertionError, creating unpredictable failure modes.
